skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts, nature, and role of accounting, and the users of accounting information. Apply accounting principles to record, measure, and report financial information. Analyze and evaluate financial statements and business performance.
Analyze financial statements and business performance using accounting principles.
Apply critical thinking to identify, classify, measure, and record accounting transactions in various business units.
Communicate effectively through writing reports and presentations in professional contexts.
Work effectively in teams and independently.
Adapt to new environments and international contexts.
Understand professional ethics and responsibilities in accounting.
